mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return over the next 20 trading days in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return over the next 20 trading days in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals growing demand in the economy, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not lead to a statistically significant positive return over the next 20 trading days in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face reduced output and profitability.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases do not lead to a statistically significant negative return over the next 20 trading days in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a potential monetary tightening cycle without inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified conditions do not lead to a statistically significant positive return over the next 60 trading days in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase, it signals a strong labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified conditions do not lead to a statistically significant positive return over the next 60 trading days in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases do not lead to a statistically significant positive return over the next 5 trading days in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is decreasing and GDP (GDPC1) is increasing, it signals a potential supply chain bottleneck, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified conditions do not lead to a statistically significant negative return over the next 60 trading days in more than 60% of instances.
